incoming_learnings: Account for publicly visible adrenaline when comparing necromancer approaches and withdrawals, but do not turn every threatened gap into a stationary summon attack. Preserve low-health death-blast spacing, bounded combat, hazard admission and mandatory pickup receipts. A locally admitted shot is not evidence of survival.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health when the planner exhausted. D1319 first exposed the unfinished pool chest while hungry. Earlier intuition menus had canceled unrelated hypotheses; neither unknown potion was identified. At D1369, both unknown singletons and usable intuition remained, but the conservative hungry information exception admitted gas and frost demands only, excluding the pool. Ordinary preparation then rejected hunger, and unfinished-chest enforcement rejected descent. A focused correction extends that same stationary information transaction to pool hypotheses without permitting drinking, movement or collection credit. A new public-evidence reduction fails on the original helper and passes after the change; all 2,446 suite tests pass, with four skipped. This is not a recovered runtime-memory reconstruction or proof that the original terminal selector, chest retrieval or subsequent survival succeeds.
review.learnings: Hungry pool preparation should retain safely admitted intuition hypotheses even when earlier generic guesses canceled. Identification attempts must remain bounded and public-menu verified; they do not establish potion identity, protection, a safe return route or collection.
